fomod.Name: Authoria - Padborn
fomod.Author: Zany + Claude
fomod.Description: The complete Authoria controller package: Gamepad++ menu + QuickLoot guard fixes (D-pad gestures no longer fire in dialogue, inventory or loot), D-pad stance switching and the full 16-slot gesture map, a combo-safe TK Dodge setup, plus the Padborn SKSE plugin - first-person block (the game can no longer switch you to first person), OStim controller layer, glyph bar, optional sprint-button move and experimental sprint rescue. 3.1.0 also takes the vanilla POV toggle off R3 in the Layout 402 controlmaps, so TDM lock-on no longer flips the camera. 3.2.0 lets your own zoom-in (mouse wheel) reach first person again; scripts still cannot force it. Supersedes Authoria - Controller Stances Fix.
